name: Pelvic Tilt & Imprint
summary: Lying on the back with knees bent, the pelvis rocks gently between neutral and a small tuck that eases the lower back towards the mat.
steps: Lie on the back, knees bent, feet hip-width, arms by the sides, spine in neutral.
Breathe out to draw the lower belly in and tip the pelvis so the lower back softens towards the mat.
Breathe in to return to neutral.

layers.title: Add a knee lift
layers.text: Float one leg to tabletop without the pelvis moving.

cautions.note: Stay near neutral; skip the tuck if it aggravates.

cues:
The belly does the work; the glutes and legs stay soft.
Ribs stay heavy.
A small movement — no pressing or gripping.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
